variables.name: pem_array
variables.comment: This array maps the characters to their 6 bit values

methods.name: protected int bytesPerAtom()
methods.comment: this class encodes three bytes per atom.

methods.name: protected int bytesPerLine()
methods.comment:
* this class encodes 57 bytes per line. This results in a maximum
     * of 57/3 * 4 or 76 characters per output line. Not counting the
     * line termination.

methods.name: protected void encodeAtom(OutputStream outStream, byte[] data, int offset, int len) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* encodeAtom - Take three bytes of input and encode it as 4
     * printable characters. Note that if the length in len is less
     * than three is encodes either one or two '=' signs to indicate
     * padding characters.

methodNames: protected void encodeAtom(OutputStream outStream, byte[] data, int offset, int len) throws IOException
